title: Sooriyan FM official live player
notes: Investigated 2026-11-06 (Asia/Calcutta). Audio source is https://radio.lotustechnologieslk.net:2020/stream/sooriyanfmgarden. MP3-like bytes observed; HTML declares conflicting MIME types, so format is based on sampled bytes. Does not prove legacy port 8006 identity or permission for RadioBee. One network feed, no separate city feeds established.

title: Vasantham FM official live player
notes: Investigated 2026-11-06 (Asia/Calcutta). Audio src exactly matches the legacy cp12.serverse.com proxy candidate. Two bounded GETs returned audio/mpeg and MP3-like frames. Official browser playback advanced to 24.464898 seconds, readyState 3, no media error. Android, long-term stability and RadioBee use permission unconfirmed. One network feed; not a unique market feed. All rights reserved footer is not third-party playback permission.

title: ITN broadcaster identity and Vasantham Radio
notes: Investigated 2026-11-06 (Asia/Calcutta). Identifies Vasantham Radio as an ITN venture for Tamil-speaking audiences. Establishes broadcaster identity, not RadioBee playback permission.

title: Akashvani official live-radio channel configuration
notes: Investigated 2026-11-06 (Asia/Calcutta). Published channels map 248 to FM Nagercoil Kumari, 297 to FM Rainbow Chennai and 9 to Akashvani Tamil Nadu. Official HTTPS HLS URLs tested twice; 302 redirects to HTTPS CloudFront playlists. HLS segments and actual playback not verified. Tamil Nadu service is not duplicated as a city feed. Editorial review reconfirmed the official station cards list Tamil and English for all three channels; these labels support ta/en catalogue tags, not a claim of listening verification.
